pages.text: Incendium's bosses are vanilla mobs rebuilt, so they do not pose for a portrait. They are found by structure.$(br2)$(bold)Torte$(), the skeleton chef, in the $(bold)Quartz Kitchen$() of the quartz flats. Fast, throws cake, deadly cake. Holds $(bold)Advanced cooking$() (Tier 2: the Nether is the trip).

$(bold)Radiation Director$() in the $(bold)Nether Reactor$() of the toxic heap: a wither skeleton overseer in a maze of radiation, far tougher than it looks once roused. Holds the reactor's $(bold)precision parts$() (Tier 3).$(br2)$(bold)Hovering Inferno$(): summoned at an $(bold)Infernal Altar$() in the dunes with a nether star. You do not kill it; you survive it. Not on the ladder: it holds loot, not a Blueprint.
